items.title: Inheritance of Rh Blood Groups (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Inheritance of Rh Blood Groups: a main subheading of 18.4.2 Rh Blood Group System, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 95-95.

blocks.text: Rh blood group system ko aik gene 'D' control karta hai. Is ke do alleles hain: D aur d. Dominant allele D Rh-antigen banata hai, jab ke recessive allele d Rh-antigen ke banne ko rokta (inhibit karta) hai. Is liye DD ya Dd genotype wale logon mein Rh-antigen hota hai aur woh Rh-positive hain, jab ke dd wale logon mein Rh-antigen nahi hota aur woh Rh-negative hain.
